prompt:
Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres, slightly soft
hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows where one
sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph / stencil print
grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Details are built from small cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
wood planks), not painted lines.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha, no chroma-key colour
behind it, no coloured fringe), every object complete and separated by clear transparent
gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the object, no text, no captions, no logos.
View: front-facing, very slight three-quarter, the same for every object on the sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Make original game sprite art on native transparent PNG. Inputs 1–2 are style references: match the paper tree atlas’s cut-paper fibre and foliage and the literature museum’s matte layered print grain. Inputs 3–4 are references only for overall arrangement and paper feel. Use none of their character, icon, interface, or text designs.
Make exactly six independent sprites in a regular 3-column by 2-row atlas, in order below. Leave generous transparent gutters and outer margin. Camera straight-on with slight downward angle, with horizontal edges parallel to the canvas and just enough top visible. Yard grid uses an orthogonal projected 24 wide by 20 deep cell; never diamond or skewed. Use a common pixel scale across all sprites. Upper left: grassTile, one full rectangular cell of muted sage paper, with 2–3 tiny cut grass blades fully inside. Upper middle: flowerBed, same exact rectangular footprint and sage paper as grassTile, covered with small white English daisy blooms, muted yellow centers; flowers stay inside edges. These two ground tiles must have continuous, square corners and precisely straight flush perimeter all the way around, with no border, chamfer, corners missing, extrusion or outer shadow whatsoever. Express the hand-cut feel inside the perimeter so edges butt up without gaps on all four sides. Upper right: benchSeat, wooden slat bench exactly twice as wide as the grass tile and one cell deep. Lower left: fencePiece, one cell wide, muted brown wooden posts with two horizontal rails and true transparent gaps, matching the extra woodFence input. Make both ends of both rails flat and at identical heights and thicknesses, so copies butt perfectly left-to-right; put posts within the module. Lower middle: stoneStool, one cell, one square light grey cut-paper stone seat with low supports, slightly visible top. Lower right: potPlant, one cell, a single terracotta pot with a compact jade plant of oval leaves on short branches. The bench, fence, stone stool and pot fill their placement footprint without crossing into another cell, with transparent open spaces and no plinth or floor graphic beneath them. Use wide atlas canvas and leave enough space for the double-width bench inside the top-right third. No paving tile, no sign, no characters.

notes: 內建 ImageGen 原生 alpha。風格輸入為 public/art/paper-atlas.png 與 art-inbox/16-literature-trial/literature.png。yard-1.webp 與 yard-3.webp 僅為版面與紙感參考，另檢視 yard-2.webp、yard-4.webp、yard-5.png。欄杆另參考 public/art/tainan/woodFence.png。實景植物參考：雛菊 https://ipm.ucanr.edu/PMG/B/W-CO-BPER-FL.001.html；玉樹 https://plants.ces.ncsu.edu/plants/crassula-ovata/ 。庭院圖集以 288 × 240 px 代表 24 × 20 的一格。草地和花圃裁齊後等尺寸放入圖集，長椅寬兩格，欄杆兩端在同一高度裁齊，保留原生 alpha。物件仍按需求單排列為 3×2。選單圖集補透明下邊距，讓兩列落在等高分格內。
